_scenario: SUCCESS PATH — URGENT single-line order with Malaysian timestamp (GMT+8)
_notes: Demonstrates timezone normalisation. The caller sends orderDate as +08:00 (Malaysian local time 10:00 AM). The ingress workflow normalises this to UTC (2026-04-10T02:00:00Z) before writing to Service Bus. The SOAP payload uses the normalised UTC value. In reporting dashboards, times are rendered as GMT+8 (10:00 AM MYT) — but the stored/transmitted value is always UTC. Expected outcome: 202 Accepted; Service Bus enqueued UTC; SOAP contains UTC timestamp.
